caveats: Results were computed in advance with the same OpenSim model on a grid and are interpolated in the browser.
Moments are capacity at full activation, not what happens during gait.
The retinaculum point has not been measured. Its medial-lateral position largely sets the hindfoot direction.
Tendon paths are straight segments, so the model cannot tell if a path passes through bone.
The midfoot is one rigid segment and there is no talonavicular joint.
Window height is measured from a medial malleolus tip estimated on a coarse 145-vertex mesh.
Net hindfoot moment sums every remaining muscle that crosses the subtalar joint.
